Simulated Network Data with an Influential Case

test_data.Rd

A dataset with 100 cases and 9 variables. The first 99 cases are sampled from the HolzingerSwineford1939 dataset (Rosseel, 2012) in the lavaan package; the 100th case is an influential case—its first nine variables are shifted by \(+2\) standard deviations from the mean of the first 99 cases. Used in examples, tests, and vignettes of netinf.

Usage

test_data

Format

A data frame with 100 rows and 9 variables:

x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9

Numeric (1–7 Likert scale). The 100th row is the influential case.

Source

The first 99 cases are a random sample from lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939. The 100th case is constructed manually as mean + 2 * sd on all 9 variables.

Examples

data("test_data", package = "netinf")
tail(test_data, 1)   # the influential case
#>           x1       x2       x3       x4       x5       x6       x7       x8
#> 100 7.488946 8.378845 4.457459 5.427352 7.042681 4.390328 6.635857 7.488547
#>           x9
#> 100 7.197295
